description: TypeScript SDK for Mimir, a Solana oracle that computes token and index prices on chain from DEX liquidity pools: read and watch prices, use a fresh price inside your own transaction, create feeds and indexes.
rules: Pass your own Solana RPC with new Mimir({ rpc }) to read on chain and to send transactions; without it, transactions go to Solana's rate-limited public RPC.
price is in USDC and is null with a reason when a feed cannot be priced; never treat it as zero.
To use a price in a Solana program, put the Mimir refresh just before your instruction in the same transaction (sendWithFreshPrice or withFreshPrice), with nothing in between.
Run createFeed({ mint, dryRun: true }) and show the cost before asking the wallet to approve a feed creation.
Pass a token mint address to createFeed, never a symbol.
